name: ResourcePicker
title: Templates/Platform/Creation/ResourcePicker
summary: The card a create flow uses to bind one resource to another: a lead, a ToggleGroup choosing between an existing resource and a new one, then either a hint over a searchable list of the existing resources with a selected mark, paged five at a time with skeleton rows while the next page loads and a polite status line for screen readers, or a Name FieldText whose helper text carries the allowed characters and turns into the required message once Next is pressed empty. The ToggleGroup disappears and the card opens on New when nothing exists to bind. ProvisionWizard binds its project with it on the first step, and its second step reuses the same paged list to pick an existing deployment. Built from `Card`, `ToggleGroup`, `FieldText`, `Input`, `HelperText`, `Item`, `Skeleton` and `Button`.

variants.name: New
variants.summary: New project: the list gives way to a Name field with the allowed characters as helper text. It only reads as required once Next is pressed with it empty.

variants.name: Loading
variants.summary: Loading the next page: five skeleton rows with staggered wire widths follow the visible projects while the load button spins.

variants.name: Required
variants.summary: Next pressed with no project selected: the required message sits under the search, above the list.
